sources.formula_transcription: q=|z-conj(z)|/(1-|z|^2); |arg((1-z^2) f'(z))| <= 2 arctan(q) if q<=1, and <= pi/2+log(q) if q>1.
sources.hypotheses: f(z)=z+a_2 z^2+..., univalent in |z|<1, all a_n real.
sources.arg_convention: The short abstract does not explicitly specify a branch convention for arg.
sources.proof_status: The abstract states that variational methods establish the inequality; no proof is included in this abstract.
sources.target_relation: The displayed functional concerns the argument of (1-z^2)f'(z), not the centered f''/f' expression itself. No implication or nonimplication between the two estimates has been proved in this retrieval task.
